image_description: A low-angle shot of a massive radio telescope dish, viewed from below. The structure features a large, circular parabolic reflector with a solid-looking rim and a complex white lattice steel support structure (truss work) underneath. Trees are visible in the foreground at the bottom left and right, providing scale. The sky is overcast.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dish dominates the frame and dwarfs the trees in the foreground, confirming colossal scale.
The rim forms a consistent ellipse (perspective circle), and the underside structure follows a logical concave depth, indicating a parabolic shape.
